description: Read-only. Suggests free positions for N sponsored trees, optionally near a point. Pass the spots to start_sponsorship, or omit spots there and the server picks them.

near_x.description: Optional x coordinate (0-8192) to search near. Needs near_y.

near_y.description: Optional y coordinate (0-8192) to search near. Needs near_x.

quantity.description: Number of trees, 1-100. Larger orders get a lower unit price.

name: find_spots
title: Find free spots
